Name: ENEMY_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Global enemy settings, including the per-player aggro scores: distance zones, aggro by damage level, multipliers when an enemy re-targets a player, and aggro from revive damage. Only row 0 is used.

Fields.Name: Sound Target - Approach Time Limit
Fields.Description: Seconds an enemy keeps going to a heard sound before giving up. After this time runs out, the sound target's own memory time starts counting down, and the target is forgotten when that reaches 0.

Fields.Name: Search Target - Approach Time Limit
Fields.Description: Seconds an enemy keeps going to a search target before giving up. After this time runs out, the search target's own memory time starts counting down, and the target is forgotten when that reaches 0.

Fields.Name: Memory Target - Approach Time Limit
Fields.Description: Seconds an enemy keeps going to a remembered target position before giving up. After this time runs out, the memory target's own memory time starts counting down, and the target is forgotten when that reaches 0.

Fields.Name: Time-of-Day Spawn - Fade Phantom ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row used as the shader while enemies that only exist at certain times of day fade in or out.

Fields.Name: Unreachable Path End - Horizontal Distance
Fields.Description: Metres. The end of an enemy's path counts as a failed approach when the target is within this horizontal distance of the path's last point and at least Unreachable Path End - Height above it (plus a steepness check).

Fields.Name: Unreachable Path End - Height
Fields.Description: Metres. How far above the path's last point the target must be for the path end to count as a failed approach (see Unreachable Path End - Horizontal Distance).

Fields.Name: Initial Aggro: Zone 1
Fields.Description: Distance-based aggro of a player closer than Distance Threshold 1: this value minus up to 10, falling linearly to the zone's outer edge. Retail: 150.

Fields.Name: Initial Aggro: Zone 2
Fields.Description: Distance-based aggro of a player between Distance Threshold 1 and 2: this value minus up to 10 across the zone. Retail: 60.

Fields.Name: Initial Aggro: Zone 3
Fields.Description: Distance-based aggro of a player between Distance Threshold 2 and 3: this value minus up to 10 across the zone. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Initial Aggro: Zone 4
Fields.Description: Distance-based aggro of a player beyond Distance Threshold 3: this value minus 0.1 per m past the threshold, never below 0. Retail: 10.

Fields.Name: Aggro Distance Threshold 1
Fields.Description: Distance in m between the enemy and a player where aggro zone 1 ends and zone 2 begins. Retail: 10.

Fields.Name: Aggro Distance Threshold 2
Fields.Description: Distance in m where aggro zone 2 ends and zone 3 begins. Retail: 20.

Fields.Name: Aggro Distance Threshold 3
Fields.Description: Distance in m where aggro zone 3 ends and zone 4 begins. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 0 (No Stagger)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 0 (No Stagger), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 10.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 1 (Short Stagger)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 1 (Short Stagger), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 2 (Medium Stagger)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 2 (Medium Stagger), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 300.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 3 (Long Stagger)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 3 (Long Stagger), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 400.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 4 (Big Launch Back)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 4 (Big Launch Back), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 1500.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 5 (Push)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 5 (Push), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 350.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 6 (Pancake)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 6 (Pancake), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 800.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 7 (Launch Back)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 7 (Launch Back), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 1000.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 8 (Minimum Stagger)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 8 (Minimum Stagger), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 9 (Air Juggle)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 9 (Air Juggle), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 1000.

Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 10 (Huge Launch Back), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 1800.

Fields.Name: Aggro: Damage Level 11 (Flailing Arms)
Fields.Description: Aggro a hit adds towards its attacker when the attack's Damage Level is 11 (Flailing Arms), unless the attack sets Override Aggro Value (AtkParam). Retail: 1500.

Fields.Name: Off-Target Multiplier 1
Fields.Description: When the enemy switches its target back to a player it has not targeted for at least Off-Target Time Point 1 seconds (but less than Time Point 2), that player's stored attack aggro is multiplied by this. Shorter times: 1. Retail: 2.

Fields.Name: Off-Target Multiplier 2
Fields.Description: As Off-Target Multiplier 1, for an off-target time from Time Point 2 to Time Point 3. Retail: 4.

Fields.Name: Off-Target Multiplier 3
Fields.Description: As Off-Target Multiplier 1, for an off-target time of Time Point 3 or more. Retail: 10.

Fields.Name: Off-Target Time Point 1
Fields.Description: Seconds without being the enemy's target from which Off-Target Multiplier 1 applies. Retail: 5.

Fields.Name: Off-Target Time Point 2
Fields.Description: Seconds without being the enemy's target from which Off-Target Multiplier 2 applies. Retail: 11.

Fields.Name: Off-Target Time Point 3
Fields.Description: Seconds without being the enemy's target from which Off-Target Multiplier 3 applies. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Target Switch Bonus Aggro
Fields.Description: Aggro added to a player's score for a short time after the enemy switches its target to that player (see Target Switch Bonus Duration). Retail: 3000.

Fields.Name: Target Switch Bonus Duration
Fields.Description: Seconds Target Switch Bonus Aggro lasts after the enemy switches to a new target. Retail: 5.

Fields.Name: Revive Damage Extra Aggro
Fields.Description: Aggro added towards a player at each interval while the player's revive-damage window is open (after they deal revive damage to a downed ally; see Revive Damage Extra Aggro Duration). Retail: 200.

Fields.Name: Revive Damage Extra Aggro Interval
Fields.Description: Seconds between the Revive Damage Extra Aggro additions. No direct read of this field was found; retail: 2.

Fields.Name: Revive Damage Extra Aggro Duration
Fields.Description: Seconds the revive-damage aggro window stays open on a player after they deal revive damage. Retail: 10.
